query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Aggregate and act on personal productivity signals across email, calendar, GitHub, LinkedIn, and SMS; additionally configure SMS receiving/sending and manage calendar access/events.
query_ground_truth.intent: Fetch text messages to monitor personal SMS productivity signals.

results.execution_guidance: Found 2 tools for this query. Look at the schemas to know how to use them.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: TelTel is a telecom operator and software provider offering tools for automated voice and SMS communication, including cloud-based contact center software, Voice/SMS API, VoIP/SIP trunking, auto dialer, webphone integration, Click2Call, and webhook-b
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=teltel. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="teltel") to create a connection BEFORE executing any teltel tools.

TELTEL_RECEIVE_INBOUND_SMS.description: Tool to process inbound SMS webhook data from TelTel. Use this to handle incoming SMS notifications that TelTel sends to your configured webhook URL. This action parses and validates the webhook payload, returning the SMS details in a structured format for further processing. Note: TelTel sends inbound SMS data via GET request with query parameters. Configure your webhook URL in TelTel account settings.

to.description: Destination number that received the SMS (your TelTel number)

time.description: Timestamp of when the SMS was received (ISO 8601 format)

msgid.description: Unique message identifier provided by TelTel

message.description: Content of the received SMS message

from_number.description: Sender's phone number who sent the SMS

TELTEL_GET_SMS_LIST.description: Tool to retrieve a list of sent (outbox) or received (inbox) SMS messages from TelTel. Use when you need to filter or paginate through SMS message history. Supports filtering by date, sender, recipient, and message state.

sort.description: Sorting field. Use '-' prefix for descending order. Multiple fields separated by comma. Default is '-id'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default is 500, max is 5000.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Leave empty for default fields.

filter.description: Filter expression. Multiple filters separated by comma. Examples: 'created_at>2021-01-01T10:00:00', 'from=37126222222', 'state=DONE'.

offset.description: Number of results to skip before returning. Default is 0.

message_type.description: Type of SMS messages to retrieve: 'outbox' for sent messages, 'inbox' for received messages.

time_info.message:
- This is time in UTC timezone. Get timezone from user if you needed.
          - Always use this time info to construct parameters for tool calls appropriately even when the tool call requires relative times like 'last week', 'last 24 hours', 'today', 'tomorrow' etc.
          - Do not hallucinate the time or timezone by yourself.
